messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Production error-rate increase detected for runtime-cluster west-1 (svc: runtime-gpu). 5xx spike + latency cliff at 12:34 UTC. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

alyssa: ack'ing, I'm oncall. seeing ~7x 5xx over baseline, p95 latency up from 120ms -> 1.2s. Pulling logs now. @mike @dov can you grab runtime traces?

mike: pulling traces. quick note: KV cache size exploded on a subset of pods (runtime-gpu-*) — memory + GC churn. I see unusual reuse counts on cache entries.

dov: reproducing a leaky pattern: requests from tenant A are occasionally returning tokens originally generated for tenant B. probably a cache key/seq-offset mismatch during continuous batching reuse.

alyssa: that matches a handful of user-complaints: garbled completions and cross-tenant leakage. tagging severity: sev2 for now due to customer impact and data isolation concern.

sam: support has two customers reporting corrupted outputs in prod, one large PLG customer. They're paused traffic and requesting ETA. I'll draft a notification after triage.

karen: please include whether this is a correctness/data-leak vs availability. customers will want specifics.

hunter: quick ML confirm — if seq offsets are wrong we can splice tokens belonging to other sessions, yep that's a correctness and PII risk. prioritize.
